method: Unchanged original redstone block classes run inside a real World (ahb, allocated without its constructor) with real Chunk (apx) and ExtendedBlockStorage objects from a stub chunk provider. Native: World.setBlock, setBlockMetadataWithNotify, notifyBlocksOfNeighborChange, notifyBlockOfNeighborChange, power queries, doesBlockHaveSolidTopSurface, isBlockNormalCubeDefault, Chunk.func_150807_a/setBlockMetadata, Block drops. Replaced: WorldServer scheduled ticks (copied: HashSet + TreeSet of original NextTickListEntry, 1000 cap, this-tick list), getTotalWorldTime, getGameRules (default GameRules), playSoundEffect/spawnEntityInWorld (recorded), spawnParticle (ignored), getEntitiesWithinAABB (a scripted entity list with strict AABB intersection: allocated item xk, zombie yq and player mw objects), loaded tile entity lists (empty ArrayLists), lighting updates (disabled). Real: TileEntityComparator (aoz) plus TileEntityChest (aow), Furnace (apg), Dispenser (apb), Hopper (api) and Dropper (apc) in native Chunk tile maps; native inventory setter calls, BlockChest blocked/double behavior, World.func_147453_f comparator updates, container comparator fullness/stack-limit reads, BlockCauldron.func_150024_a and BlockEndPortalFrame overrides, ItemReed-style placement (setBlock(block,0,3) then onBlockPlacedBy with a placer yaw). The wire's blocksNeedingUpdate HashSet is replaced by a fresh one per scenario; the JVM is Java 8+ (HashMap iteration order of Java 8 and later). Terrain is written straight into chunk sections; events of tick t run before tick t (world time advances, then tickUpdates). No random block ticks. Per tick: changed region cells [x,y,z,id,meta], and the call log: E,op event; s,x,y,z,id,meta,flags setBlock; m,x,y,z,meta,flags setBlockMetadataWithNotify; n,x,y,z,source notifyBlockOfNeighborChange; t,x,y,z,id,delay,priority scheduled tick; u,x,y,z,id updateTick; p,name sound; e,item dropped item; T world tick; scripted events place, air, use, placeby (block, yaw), cauldron (water level), container (block id), slot (slot, item, count, damage), notify (target cell, source id), entity (0 item, 1 mob, 2 player), unentity, collide (onEntityCollidedWithBlock with a null entity). tiles (only when non-empty): per tick [x,y,z,signal] changes of the TileEntityComparator output signal. sounds: [tick,x,y,z,name,volume,pitch]; drops: [tick,x,y,z,item,count,damage]; pending: [x,y,z,id,ticksLeft,priority]; rng: world Random nextInt() after the run.
